description: The apply switch for the coded document closes C3 junk_proof and C8 fraud_document (scripts/credit_review/doc_close.py). One entry per rule; a rule's apply rows are written only while its entry has apply_enabled true WITH approved_by, approval_ref and an approved customer-facing closing line (closing_line_campaign: nothing is closed without telling the user), names the rule id the code runs, the paying list is known, at most DAILY_CAP apply closes are written per UTC day, and no kill file is present (/etc/hydra/doc-close.disabled, /etc/hydra/fable-trays.disabled, /etc/hydra/fable-decider.disabled). Every apply row carries a batch id. Both rules ship off; shadow rows are unaffected. Turning a rule on is a one-line reviewed PR to this file that cites its approval.

r5_go_gate.ruling: Captain 2026-11-14 ~22:4xZ, verbatim: "tell it i said to do it" - retiring the r5 GO gate by name, after Fable said the captain should retire that gate by name. Standing rule, verbatim: "there should be no humans involved except the customers giving proof and their statements."
r5_go_gate.scope: Apply no longer waits on an r5 GO. The ruling retires the gate; it does not turn apply on. Each rule below stays off until its own entry is flipped.
